2. The facts relevant for the purposes of disposal of the rule are that the opposite party No. 2 as plaintiff instituted the suit against the petitioners (defendants Nos. 24, 25 and 56) opposite party No. 1 and opposite parties 3 to 61 as defendants for partition for getting a specific saham of the land out of the suit land. The defendants Nos. 23, 26, 28, 29, 30, 35 and 40 contested the suit by filing written statements and also prayed for sahams. By his judgment dated 31-1-67 the learned Subordinate Judge decreed the suit in part and granted sahams to the contesting defendants and the defendants petitioners. 

 3. Against the decision of the learned Subordinate Judge the contesting defendants preferred Title Appeal No. 59/67 before the District Judge, Comilla and it was heard by the learned Additional District Judge, Comilla, who by his judgment and order dated 12-8-69 allowed the appeal set aside the judgment and decree of the learned Subordinate Judge, dated 31-1-67 and sent the case back on remand to the Title Court for retrial with certain observations. Against the order of remand dated 12-8-69 the plaintiff filed S. M. A. No. 19/70 before the Dhaka High Court and the appeal was summarily dismissed on 3-3-72.
